book.name: 1 Kurintu
book.title: Ka An-anayan no Sulat ni Pablo to mgo Taga Kurintu

content: Ka igpabulig to mgo nigtuu no taga Hirusalim
Kuntoon, sikaniu no mgo nigtuu no taga Kurintu, tongod to salapi no igbulig now to mgo nigtuu no dio to ugpaan to Hudia, ilinga now ka insugu ku to mgo nigtuu no dio to ugpaan to Galasia.

Tibo Dominggu, tag sagboka kaniu, panagana kow to igbogoy now ko songo monu ka koykow no noumaan. No limura now woy isabuksabuk now pad oyow, ko ogdatong a, konad og-awoson to ogpan-am-amutoy kow pad.

Ko ogdatong ad on dio to kaniu, litos no igbogoy now ka salapi ko hontow ka ogkasaligan now. Pogkaponga, igbogoy ku kandan ka sulat no igpatilaa dio to Hirusalim woy igpaalap ku kandan ka igpabogoy now to mgo nigtuu dio.
Ko inat to og-awoson to songo oghondio ad, ogdumoon ku ro sikandan.
Ka mgo tuud ni Pablo
Ogpanumbaloy a dio to kaniu di oghun-a a pad ogpanumbaloy dio to ugpaan to Masidonia su ogtuuran ku to ogbayo dio to Masidonia.
Ko ogpokouma a dio to kaniu, og-ugpo a buwa pad. Songo kuwo buwa ko woy ad oghipanow ko ogkapongaan on ka tiglongdong oyow ogpakabulig kow kanak ko ogligkat a dio to agad hondoi a ogpakarolog.
Ian su to soini no ighondio ku kaniu, kono a ogkoiniat no ogsagpit a ro duon su og-iman-iman a ko ogmalugoy a pad poron to kaniu ko igbogoy to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta.
Di kuntoon, kai a pad og-ugpo to lunsud to Episu taman to allow to Pagkoonan to Pintikustis.
Agad to mohon-ing ka ogpakaatang poron to ignangonnangon ku di og-ugpo a ro pad kai su mohon-ing pad ka magaan ogtuu no ogpamminog to kinagian to Magboboot.
Ko ogpokouma si Timoteo dio to kaniu, sagmana now sikandin su ogkoiling kanak no songo ogpaagad-agad to igsugu to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta.
Kono now oglomotomi sikandin. No ko oghipanow on, buligi now sikandin oyow ogkarago so goinawa rin no ogpokouli kai to kanak su ogtagaran ku sikandin woy ka ogduma kandin no nigtuu.
Si Apulus no sulod ta, malasi a nigbuyu to oyow ogduma to sikan no mgo nigtuu no ogpanumbaloy dio to kaniu. Di waro pad noiniat sikandin to ogduma. Di ko duon liwak din oghondio dod kun to kaniu.
Ka igtuguntugun ni Pablo
Tantanuri now, hogoti now woy manokala now ka pogtuu now no kono now ig-ulung-ulung.
No to tibo no oghimuon ta, og-awoson to ian ta igpapitow ta ka dakol no goinawa ta to duma ta.
Kuntoon, mgo sulod, nataga kow to si Istipanas no mal-alunggun ka an-anayan no otow dio to ugpaan to Girisia no nigtuu ki Hisus woy ungod ogbulig to mgo nigtuu.
Sikan ian mgo sulod, ogbuyu a kaniu, to oyow ogpamminog kow to mgo otow no ogkounawa ki Istipanas woy ka tibo no talagbulig kandin.
Narago ad no nokouma on kai si Istipanas, si Portunatu, woy si Akaiku. Ian su sikandan, nohimu no magalawa now no inliwan kaniu no taga Kurintu no waro kow makaruma.

Ian su nigmaroyow ran ka kanak no goinawa no ogkounawa to pogmaroyow ran to kaniu no goinawa ko ogpokouli on sikandan dio to kaniu. Nò, litos no ogsayoon ka mgo otow no ogkoiling to kandan no batasan.

Ka mgo nigtuu no dio to ugpaan to Asia no oglimudlimud no og-ampu, ogpapangumusta kaniu. No si Akila woy si Prisila woy ka mgo nigtuu no ogkalimud to og-ampu dio to kandan no baloy, songo igpanangon dan dio to kaniu to dakol so goinawa ran kaniu su nasagboka kow kandan to pogtuu to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta no si Hisus.
No ka tibo no nigtuu no kai to Ipisu, igpanangon dan to songo ogpangumusta kun kaniu tibo. Sikaniu dio no nigtuu, songo pakumkumustooy kow ko ogpakitkitooy kow su duma now to ogtuu.
Nò, kanak no si Pablo, bolad ku lagboy ka ogsulat to soini to, “Kumusta kow!”

Ko duon otow no waro goinawa rin to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta, litos ko ogkalogparan to Magboboot sikandin. Soini ka ig-ampu ku, Maranata, no ka lituk to sikan, Lagboy no Igbuyag noy, magaan ka ro oglibong kai.
Ogbuyu a ki Hisus no Lagboy no Igbuyag ta to oyow ogkohoy-uan kow nikandin.
Ignangon ku kaniu to dakol so goinawa ku kaniu tibo su nasagboka ka goinawa ta ki Hisu Kristu. Sikan ian taman. Kanak si Pablo.

footnotes.text: Ka lunsud to Hirusalim, duon to ugpaan to Hudia.
Ogkabasa to Levitico 23:15 woy Deuteronomio 16:9. Tongod to Pagkoonan to Pintikustis, basa ka to ingkasulat dio to diralom to pagina no duon Hinimuan 2:1.
Ka Girisia, dangob no ngaran to ugpaan to Akaya.
To Ginirigu, songo kuwo ko ogkalituk to “mgo otow no ogkounawa ki Istipanas woy ka agad hontow no duma ta no og-ay-ayaran to igpohimu to Lagboy no Igbuyag ta.”
